purpose: Test one structurally new path-dependent equity portfolio-insurance baseline that seeks materially higher SPY participation than balanced portfolios while reducing major drawdowns.

research_basis.mechanism: time-invariant portfolio protection (TIPP), a ratcheting-floor CPPI variant
research_basis.selection_reason: It changes exposure from portfolio cushion rather than momentum, trend, volatility forecasts, market-state routing, or static diversification.

alternatives_not_selected.option_based_tail_hedge: requires reliable historical option surfaces and execution assumptions unavailable on the free data stack
alternatives_not_selected.managed_futures_overlay: tradable ETF histories are too short for the required prehistory replication
alternatives_not_selected.factor_rotation: would overlap prior factor and momentum families and lacks a synchronized prehistory ETF record
alternatives_not_selected.additional_trend_or_volatility_rules: would be parameter variants of mechanisms that already failed the locked baseline gates

frozen_candidate.cash_assumption_reason: Conservative and reproducible from immutable Phase 010 outputs without a new data transfer.

interpretation_rule: A pass creates a candidate for separate frozen validation only. A failure retires this exact mechanism without parameter variants.
